plan.needResult: Run a test to see the ratio to your plan and whether the minimum guaranteed speed is met.
notes: In Korea, KT, SK Broadband and LG U+ set the minimum guaranteed speed at 50% of the plan speed (100M → 50M, 500M → 250M, 1G → 500M).
Even on a 1G plan, a wired 1Gbps LAN port tops out around 930–940Mbps due to overhead. A CAT.5 (100Mbps) cable caps you at 100Mbps.
Over Wi‑Fi, depending on router/device standard (Wi‑Fi 5/6/7), distance, walls and channel congestion, 200–600Mbps on a gigabit plan is common.

Fee reductions for missing the minimum guaranteed speed are judged by your ISP's own speed test site, not this tool or the NIA test. If 60% or more of at least 5 wired tests within 30 minutes fall below the guarantee, that day's fee is reduced, so if it keeps happening, test on your ISP's site and contact them.

caveats.title: Why results can be lower than your plan
items: Wi‑Fi: distance to the router, walls and channel interference are the biggest factors. Use a LAN cable for an accurate result.
Device & browser limits: older laptops/phones, power saving and the browser itself can under-report speeds above a few hundred Mbps.
Other traffic: videos in other tabs, cloud sync and other devices at home take bandwidth away from the test.
VPN & security software: rerouting or inspecting traffic slows it down.
Server location: this measures to the nearest Cloudflare server (usually Seoul, ICN). Overseas or specific game servers may differ.

speedTest.title: Internet Speed Test
speedTest.description: Measure download and upload speed, ping and jitter against Cloudflare servers.
speedTest.historyEmpty: No tests yet. Up to 30 recent results are saved in this browser.
speedTest.slowDesc: Under 25 Mbps — basic browsing, SD video
speedTest.disclaimer: Results vary with network conditions, server location and device performance, and are for reference only. One test can use up to a few hundred MB of data in total, so be careful on mobile data.
guideSection1Items: Download speed: how fast you receive data (Mbps). Affects streaming and file downloads
Upload speed: how fast your device sends data. Affects video calls, live streaming and cloud backups
Ping: round-trip time to the server (ms, lower is better). Affects game responsiveness
Jitter: how much ping fluctuates (ms). High jitter breaks up calls and makes games stutter
Mbps vs MB/s: 1MB/s = 8Mbps. A 100Mbps connection downloads about 12.5MB per second
guideSection2Items: A wired LAN connection gives more accurate results than Wi‑Fi.
Test when no other tabs, apps or devices are using the network.
Test at different times of day to see evening peak-hour quality too.
Speeds may be lower when using a VPN.
If you keep falling short of your plan, request a fee reduction based on results from your ISP's own speed test site. Use the official NIA test (speed.nia.or.kr) as an independent reference.
